newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-SMITH SHUFFLES FRONT ROW AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SMITH SHUFFLES FRONT ROW AGAIN.

text.p: Australia recalled prop Richard Harry on Tuesday for the Tri-Nations rugby union test against New Zealand in Melbourne on July 26 as coach Greg Smith experimented further in search of his best front-row combination.
Fellow prop Andrew Heath also won promotion to a 23-man squad for the clash with the Tri-Nations holders at the Melbourne Cricket Ground..

Harry and Heath replaced Cameron Blades and Ewen McKenzie in the the only changes to the squad selected for Australia's 25-6 victory in a one-off test against Triple Crown winners England in Sydney last Saturday. Blades made his debut in that match.
New South Wales forward Harry has made a rapid comeback after he was dumped following Australia' heavy loss to the All Blacks in a Bledisloe Cup match in Christchurch 10 days ago.
Smith, who blamed weakness in the front row as a key factor in that defeat, said the latest changes were designed to add power to the scrum.
But he admitted there was still a lot of work to be done in the forwards if they were to match the All Blacks, rated by Smith as easily the best team in the world at the moment.
"It's really only a major area of concern against one team (New Zealand) in the world but we do aspire to be better than that team," Smith said.
"So we've got to continue to work at the area that does concern us and that's exactly what we're doing."
Apart from changing the props, Smith has also experimented with both Michael Foley and Marco Caputo at hooker this season.
"We are confident Richard Harry will do well, while Andrew Heath will generate power in the scrum," he said.
Smith said he would probably make another change to the starting line-up in the forwards by recalling Michael Brial at number eight at the expense of Troy Coker.
Backs - Matt Burke, George Gregan, Mitch Hardy, James Holbeck, Tim Horan, Stephen Larkham, Jason Little, Ben Tune, Sam Payne, Joe Roff.
Forwards - Michael Brial, Andrew Blades, Marco Caputo, Matt Cockbain, Troy Coker, John Eales, Michael Foley, Richard Harry, Andrew Heath, Danial Manu, Garrick Morgan, Brett Robinson, David Wilson.
